newsitem.title: USA: Atmel up amid book-to-bill anticipation.
newsitem.headline: Atmel up amid book-to-bill anticipation.

text.p: Atmel Corp shares rose in moderately heavy trading on Monday, partly on momentum from breaking through a technical barrier and in anticipation of the semiconductor book-to-bill ratio, due out today after the markets close.
"Its broke through the 200-day moving average," said a market maker at the Chicago Board Options Exchange. "It has been down recently and oversold. It's just bouncing back."
Shares rose 1-7/8 to 30-3/4 at midafternoon. One trader noted the stock began a move down Oct 15 from about 30-3/8 to about 25-3/8 at the end of the month, and has climbed back up since Nov 1.
Atmel makes complex integrated circuits for high-performance computers.
The Philadelphia semiconductor index rose 4.24 to 211.55.
